step1_pattern.operation: P&G 报告的调整后自由现金流 ÷ 净销售额
notes: FCF 用的是 P&G 自定义的非 GAAP "Adjusted Free Cash Flow"（MD&A p25），不是 q_Ra026 的 经营现金流 − 资本开支

changes_vs_seed: 题干：只替换时间表达，其余与原题一字不差

step5_question.question_previous_version: Based on Procter & Gamble's Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, what is P&G's free cash flow margin for fiscal 2026 based on its reported Adjusted Free Cash Flow, and how does it compare to fiscal 2025? Report percentages rounded to one decimal place.
step5_question.gt_template:
Free Cash Flow Margin is Free Cash Flow divided by Net Sales. For 2026:

Free Cash Flow = $[[AdjFCF@FY2026]] million (P&G's reported Adjusted Free Cash Flow)
Free Cash Flow Margin = $[[AdjFCF@FY2026]] million / $[[Rev@FY2026]] million = [[FCFMargin@FY2026|.1f]]%
For 2025:

Free Cash Flow Margin = $[[AdjFCF@FY2025]] million / $[[Rev@FY2025]] million = [[FCFMargin@FY2025|.1f]]%
The margin [[!FCFMargin_change]] from [[FCFMargin@FY2025|.1f]]% in 2025 to [[FCFMargin@FY2026|.1f]]% in 2026.
